notes.title: Tiny pause menu change
notes.content: Changed the quit button while playing the game be a quit to menu button where you can switch to other game types or completely quit the game from there.

notes.title: Barrel Challenge Record Marker
notes.content:
Small update to add a marker in the Barrel Challenge mini game to see where the current record distance is in game.

Updated the main menu for better leaderboard readability.
